detail.longDescription: It's # FairtradeMusicFriday ! Here's a new submission thread for November. Submit your own release or someone else's, it can be by # FediMusicians or not. It should be hosted on an open platform like # Faircamp , # JamCoop , # Mirlo or # SelfHosted , or on a platform fair to artists like # Bandcamp or # Subvert . As long as it is by an # IndieArtist - it doesn't even need to be new. Just make a direct public comment (with a link & description) to this post and it will appear at https://isitfairtrademusicfri.day automagically! Buying or boosting will make an artist's day 💙
